text: his own conceit: Heb. his own eyes
are not equal: Heb. are lifted up
As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool: Or, as he that putteth a precious stone in an heap of stones
The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors: Or, a great man grieveth all, and he hireth the fool, he hireth also transgressors
returneth to his folly: Heb. iterateth his folly
it grieveth him: Or, he is weary
Where no wood is: Heb. without wood | talebearer: Or, whisperer | ceaseth: Heb. is silent
speaketh fair: Heb. maketh his voice gracious
Whose hatred is covered by deceit: Or, hatred is covered into secret
